    s = s.strip()

    if m:
        return u'数+单位', [m.group(1), m.group(2)]
    m = re.match(u'^([A-Z][A-Z_0-9]{3,}) (' + TU + u')\\b', s)
    if m:

    m = re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)? ?\\* ?[A-Za-z]', s)
    if m:
        return u'算式', [w[0] + u' ' + w[1] + u' ' + w[2] if len(w) > 2 else s]
    m = re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]* \\(', s)

    if w and re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)?[.,]?$', w[0]):

    if w and w[0].strip(u'.,').upper() in (u'TRUE', u'FALSE'):

def secnum(x):
    m = re.match(u'^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)*\\.?)\\s\\s+(?=[A-Z])', x.lstrip())

def find_body(i, nd):
    got = -1

    head = q[:16]
    for a in range(len(LL[i])):
        win = NL.join(LL[i][a:a + 4])
        if head not in pnorm(win):
            continue
        face, offs = foldmap(win)
        j = face.find(q)
        if j < 0:
            continue
        row = line_at(offs, j)
        if row is not None and not toc_line(LL[i][a + row]):
            got = a + row
    return got

            b += 1
    elif kind == u'para':
        while b < len(LL[i]) and LL[i][b].strip() != u'' and not ffline(LL[i][b].strip()):
            b += 1
    elif kind == u'label':
        while b < len(LL[i]):

            if re.fullmatch(u'[A-Za-z ]+constants:', s) or secnum(LL[i][b]) is not None:

def slot_shape(s):
    s = s.strip()
    w = s.split()
    m = re.match(u'^(\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)?) (' + TU + u') ?\\((\\d[\\d,]*) (' + TU + u')\\)', s)
    if m:
        return u'数+单位(括号换算)', [m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)]
    m = re.match(u'^(\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)?) (' + TU + u')\\b', s)
    if m:
        return u'数+单位', [m.group(1), m.group(2)]
    m = re.match(u'^([A-Z][A-Z_0-9]{3,}) (' + TU + u')\\b', s)
    if m:
        return u'变量名+单位', [m.group(1), m.group(2)]
    m = re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)? ?\\* ?[A-Za-z]', s)
    if m:
        return u'算式', [w[0] + u' ' + w[1] + u' ' + w[2] if len(w) > 2 else s]
    m = re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]* \\(', s)
    if m:
        return u'裸数(括号注)', [w[0]]
    if w and re.match(u'^\\d[\\d,]*(?:\\.\\d+)?[.,]?$', w[0]):
        return u'裸数', [w[0].strip(u'.,')]
    if w and w[0].strip(u'.,').upper() in (u'TRUE', u'FALSE'):
        return u'布尔字', [w[0].strip(u'.,')]
    if w and w[0].strip(u'.,').lower() in (u'unset', u'none', u'enabled', u'disabled', u'ipv4', u'ipv6'):
        return u'开关/交回字', [w[0].strip(u'.,')]
    return u'散文/交回', [w[0] if w else s]

def rd(p):
    return io.open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()


def pnorm(s):
    """最宽档: 小写 + 引号撇音符整枚删除 + 连字符族归一 + 只留 [0-9a-z 汉字 . - 空格] + 空白折一。"""
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(u'[' + u'\u2019\u2018\'`\u00b4' + u']+', u'', s)
    s = re.sub(u'[\u2010-\u2015\u2212-]', u'-', s)
    s = re.sub(u'[^0-9a-z\u4e00-\u9fff\\-\\. ]+', u' ', s)
    return re.sub(u'\\s+', u' ', s).strip()


def cnt_sub(needle, face):
    """非重叠游标环(不用 re.findall)。"""
    n, c, i = len(needle), 0, 0
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    while True:
        j = face.find(needle, i)
        if j < 0:
            return c
        c += 1
        i = j + n


def occ_token(needle, face):
    """词形档: 前后邻字不得是 [0-9a-z]——游标环 + 字符判定, 不交引擎。"""
    n, c, i, m = len(needle), 0, 0, len(face)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    while True:
        j = face.find(needle, i)
        if j < 0:
            return c
        a, b = j - 1, j + n
        ok_a = not (a >= 0 and face[a] in _ALNUM)
        ok_b = not (b < m and face[b] in _ALNUM)
        if ok_a and ok_b:
            c += 1
        i = j + 1


_ALNUM = set(u'0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')


def cnt_line(needle, rows):
    """严格档: 针完整落在某一行(行折一后)内的非重叠出现数。"""
    return sum(cnt_sub(needle, r) for r in rows)


def sents_manual(txt):
    """手工状态机切句: 折面后遇 .!? 且下一字符是空格则切; 不吞尾空段。"""
    f = u' '.join(txt.split())
    out, start, k, n = [], 0, 0, len(f)
    while k < n:
        ch = f[k]
        if ch in u'.!?' and (k + 1 >= n or f[k + 1] == u' '):
            seg = f[start:k + 1]
            if seg.strip():
                out.append(seg)
            start = k + 1
        k += 1
    if start < n and f[start:].strip():
        out.append(f[start:])
    return out


def shell_line(x):
    """页壳判: strip 后按 token 形状, 不用多支正则。"""
    t = x.strip().split()
    if not t:
        return True
    if x == u'\x0c' or t == [u'\x0c']:
        return True
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[-2] == u'[Page' and t[-1].endswith(u']') and t[-1][:-1].isdigit():
        return True
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] == u'RFC' and t[1].isdigit():
        return True
    if len(t) == 1 and t[0][:3] == u'RFC' and t[0][3:].isdigit():
        return True
    if t == [u'Internet', u'Engineering', u'Task', u'Force']:
        return True
    if t == [u'Network', u'Working', u'Group']:
        return True
    if len(t) == 4 and t[:3] == [u'Request', u'for', u'Comments:'] and t[3].isdigit():
        return True
    return False

def scan_pairs(text):
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(text)
    low = text.lower()
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        if not c.isdigit() or (i > 0 and (text[i - 1].isalnum() or text[i - 1] == u'.')):
            i += 1
            continue
        j, sepd = i, 0
        while j < n and (text[j].isdigit()
                         or (sepd == 0 and text[j] in u'.,' and j + 1 < n and text[j + 1].isdigit())):
            if text[j] in u'.,':
                sepd = 1
            j += 1
        num = text[i:j]
        k = j
        while k < n and text[k] == u' ':
            k += 1
        rest = low[k:k + 24]
        for u_ in UNIT_SORTED:
            if rest.startswith(u_) and not (rest[len(u_):len(u_) + 1].isalpha()):
                out.append((num, u_))
                break
        i = j
    return sorted(set(out))

def dft_tok(seg):
    """切片 + partition 取 'Default:' 后的 token(不用正则)。"""
    head, sep, tail = seg.partition(u'Default:')
    if not sep:
        return None
    tail = tail.lstrip()
    return tail.split(u' ')[0].strip(u'.') if tail else None

def blk_fold(i, qa, qb):
    fa, fb = SHP[i].find(qa), SHP[i].find(qb)

    for _ln in NOSHP[i].split(chr(10)):

    return (SHP2RAW[i][bisect.bisect_right(_cum, fa)],

def cinit_fold(s):
    start = s.find(u'ip6addrlbl_init_table[] = {')
    if start < 0:
        return []
    p = s.index(u'{', start + len(u'ip6addrlbl_init_table[] = ')) + 1
    n, d, ent, out = len(s), 1, u'', []
    while p < n:
        c = s[p]
        if c == u'{':
            d += 1
            if d == 2:
                ent = u''
        elif c == u'}':
            d -= 1
            if d == 1:
                if u'.label' in ent:
                    out.append(fold_chars(ent))
                ent = u''
            elif d == 0:
                break
        elif d >= 2:
            ent += c
        p += 1
    return out

def win_after(lines, needle, stops, cap=60):
    a = -1
    for k, l in enumerate(lines):
        if needle in l:
            a = k
            break
    if a < 0:
        return -1, -1
    b = min(a + cap, len(lines) - 1)
    for k in range(a + 1, b + 1):
        s = lines[k].strip()
        if any(x in s for x in stops):
            return a + 1, k - 1
    return a + 1, b

def pfx8(tok):
    if u':' not in tok:
        return tok
    body, _, plen = tok.partition(u'/')
    tail = (u'/' + plen) if plen else u''
    if u'::' in body:
        left = [x for x in body.split(u'::')[0].split(u':') if x]
        right = [x for x in body.split(u'::')[1].split(u':') if x]
        fill = 8 - len(left) - len(right)
        g = left + [u'0'] * (fill if fill > 0 else 0) + right
    else:
        g = body.split(u':')
    g = [x if x else u'0' for x in g][:8]
    while len(g) < 8:
        g.append(u'0')
    return u':'.join(g) + tail

def cinit_fold(s):
    start = s.find(u'ip6addrlbl_init_table[] = {')
    if start < 0:
        return []
    p = s.index(u'{', start + len(u'ip6addrlbl_init_table[] = ')) + 1
    n, d, ent, out = len(s), 1, u'', []
    while p < n:
        c = s[p]
        if c == u'{':
            d += 1
            if d == 2:
                ent = u''
        elif c == u'}':
            d -= 1
            if d == 1:
                if u'.label' in ent:
                    out.append(fold_chars(ent))
                ent = u''
            elif d == 0:
                break
        elif d >= 2:
            ent += c
        p += 1
    return out

def win_after(lines, needle, stops, cap=60):
    a = -1
    for k, l in enumerate(lines):
        if needle in l:
            a = k
            break
    if a < 0:
        return -1, -1
    b = min(a + cap, len(lines) - 1)
    for k in range(a + 1, b + 1):
        s = lines[k].strip()
        if any(x in s for x in stops):
            return a + 1, k - 1
    return a + 1, b

def pfx8(tok):
    if u':' not in tok:
        return tok
    body, _, plen = tok.partition(u'/')
    tail = (u'/' + plen) if plen else u''
    if u'::' in body:
        left = [x for x in body.split(u'::')[0].split(u':') if x]
        right = [x for x in body.split(u'::')[1].split(u':') if x]
        fill = 8 - len(left) - len(right)
        g = left + [u'0'] * (fill if fill > 0 else 0) + right
    else:
        g = body.split(u':')
    g = [x if x else u'0' for x in g][:8]
